subject: BUG-258: answer keys sit inside _app and are protected ONLY by firebase.json's hosting ignore, so any copy re-exposes them
description: Found by Mallory during the HEXOS-6 vote; counts re-verified. deploy.sh gate 3.6 (_tools/qa/skill-map-audit.py) exists because three answer-key classes were found live in production on 2026-08-05. The remedy was NOT to move them out of _app: it was to add them to firebase.json's hosting ignore list so the Firebase CLI skips them at deploy. Verified that ignore works (https://hexworth.com/lab-skill-maps/ returns 404). But the files are still physically present: _app/lab-skill-maps holds 1584 files (34 top-level yaml plus subdirectories), 25 of the yamls contain literal FLAG{, and _app/houses/matrix/handouts holds 4 instructor walkthrough PDFs, one of which opens with 'INSTRUCTOR SOLUTION GUIDE ... CONFIDENTIAL - Not for distribution to students ... Contains flag answers' and gives a literal stage flag on page 2. THE RISK IS THAT THE PROTECTION IS A PROPERTY OF ONE TOOL, NOT OF THE FILESYSTEM. Any process that copies _app by other means re-opens the hole gate 3.6 closed: a HEXOS-6 image build, a backup, a static mirror, an rsync to a demo box, a zip for a conference. HEXOS-6 is what surfaced it and the panel voted A (no bundled _app) partly for this reason, but the exposure is latent regardless of whether 6 ships. Fix direction: relocate answer-key content OUT of _app entirely so the web root cannot contain it, leaving the hosting ignore as belt-and-braces rather than as the only belt.
